name: marc-jones
description: A golden-era point-and-click adventure — Monkey Island 2 / Fate of Atlantis mood, 2026 hi-bit pixel art, modern haptics — running in browser, mobile, and desktop from one codebase. Adapted from the story "The Big Glitch": a playable book about the year the AI economy died of a quadrillion small errors.
